title: Freezer Sensor Fault
fullDescription: Control board cannot read freezer thermistor. Sensor open or shorted. Compressor may run continuously.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug freezer 10 minutes then restore power.

fixSteps.title: Check sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Test thermistor for ~5kΩ at 32°F. Replace if open.

whenToCallPro: If wiring harness is damaged inside cabinet.

faq.a: Move food to backup if compressor stays off.

title: Evaporator Fan Fault
fullDescription: Fan stalled or motor failed. Causes warm freezer and frost buildup.

fixSteps.title: Defrost
fixSteps.instruction: Manually defrost 24 hours with door open.

fixSteps.title: Replace fan
fixSteps.instruction: Swap evaporator fan motor if no spin after defrost.

faq.a: Defrost cycle failure or door seal leak.

title: Defrost Heater Fault
fullDescription: Heater element burned out or fuse blown. Frost accumulates on coils.

fixSteps.title: Replace
fixSteps.instruction: Install new defrost heater and thermal fuse.

faq.a: Short term yes, but expect ice buildup.

title: Communication Error
shortDescription: Display board lost contact with main control.
fullDescription: Ribbon cable or PCB failure between user interface and main board.

fixSteps.title: Reseat cable
fixSteps.instruction: Open control housing, reseat ribbon cable.

whenToCallPro: If reseating fails board replacement needed.

title: Door Open Alarm
shortDescription: Door has been open too long.
fullDescription: Door switch sensed open >2 minutes or switch failed stuck open.

fixSteps.title: Close firmly
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure door fully shut and seal clean.

fixSteps.title: Replace switch
fixSteps.instruction: Test and replace door switch if reads stuck.

title: Ambient Sensor Fault
fullDescription: External thermistor reading out of range.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Locate and swap ambient thermistor near control housing.

title: Compressor Fault
fullDescription: Start relay or compressor windings issue. Inverter board may have failed.

title: High Temperature Alarm
fullDescription: Freezer warmer than -5°F for sustained period; food safety alert.

fixSteps.title: Inspect gasket
fixSteps.instruction: Check door seal with paper test; replace if loose.

faq.a: Discard if above 40°F more than 2 hours.

title: Defrost Cycle Timeout
shortDescription: Defrost did not complete in expected time.
fullDescription: Heater not reaching cutoff temp; thermostat or heater fault.

fixSteps.title: Test thermostat
fixSteps.instruction: Verify defrost thermostat closes cold; replace if open.

whenToCallPro: If accessing back of evap is difficult.

title: Voltage Out of Range
shortDescription: Supply voltage too high or low.
fullDescription: Inverter detects line voltage outside operating window.

fixSteps.title: Check outlet
fixSteps.instruction: Measure outlet 110-125V. Move to dedicated circuit.
